test_cases.title: Invoice Generation shows its Generate Invoices button for an admin with the role
acs: DERIVED: Invoice Generation is available to users with the Generate Invoices role - InvoiceGeneration.aspx

steps.action: Open System Administration > Manage Roles and tick Generate Invoices for yourself.
steps.expected: The role is saved.

steps.action: Open Home and Manage Contracts.
steps.expected: The menu lists Invoice Generation.

steps.action: Click Invoice Generation.
steps.expected: The Invoice Generation page opens.

steps.action: Check the buttons on the page.
steps.expected: A Generate Invoices button is shown.

steps.action: Do not click Generate Invoices; untick the role again.
steps.expected: The role is removed.

A customer cannot be deleted, so the test leaves it inactive.
test_cases.title: A new customer with every required field is saved
acs: DERIVED: A customer can be created when every required field is filled - Customer.aspx.vb ButtonSave_Click

steps.action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers > Create Customer.
steps.expected: The empty Create Customer form opens.

steps.action: Fill the required fields with synthetic values and choose a Customer Type and both Countries.
steps.expected: The fields show the values.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: An alert says Customer details saved successfully.

steps.action: Check the buttons after the save.
steps.expected: Go to Participants Page and Go to Contracts Page appear.

steps.action: Untick Active and Save again.
steps.expected: The test customer is set inactive.

test_cases.title: Printing a group address label is answered by the page
acs: DERIVED: Print on Group Address Labels reports the result of the label request - GroupAddress.aspx.vb LinkButtonPrint_Click

steps.action: Open Distributions > Group Address Labels.
steps.expected: The list of group addresses opens.

steps.action: Check the Print column.
steps.expected: A Print link is shown on each row.

steps.action: Click Print on the first row.
steps.expected: The page reloads.

steps.action: Read the message above the list.
steps.expected: It says Label sent to Printer or Error Printing Label.

steps.action: Check the page after the print.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.
